类 Geometry

java.lang.Object
Geometry
public class Geometry extends Object
Geometry Calculator Program This program provides methods to calculate areas, circumferences, and perimeters of various geometric shapes including circles, rectangles, and triangles.

  • 方法详细资料

    • main

      public static void main(String[] arg)
      The main method that runs the geometry calculator program. It displays a menu, gets user choice, prompts for necessary inputs, calls the appropriate calculation methods, and displays results.
      参数:
      args - command line arguments (not used)

    • printMenu

      public static void printMenu()
      Task 1: Prints the menu of options for the geometry calculator. This method displays all available calculations the user can choose from. It takes no parameters and returns no value.

    • circleArea

      public static double circleArea(double radius)
      Task 2: Calculates the area of a circle. The formula used is A = π * r²
      参数:
      radius - the radius of the circle (must be positive)
      返回:
      the area of the circle

    • rectangleArea

      public static double rectangleArea(double length, double width)
      Task 2: Calculates the area of a rectangle. The formula used is A = length * width
      参数:
      length - the length of the rectangle (must be positive)
      width - the width of the rectangle (must be positive)
      返回:
      the area of the rectangle

    • triangleArea

      public static double triangleArea(double base, double height)
      Task 2: Calculates the area of a triangle. The formula used is A = (1/2) * base * height
      参数:
      base - the base length of the triangle (must be positive)
      height - the height of the triangle (must be positive)
      返回:
      the area of the triangle

    • circleCircumference

      public static double circleCircumference(double radius)
      Task 2: Calculates the circumference of a circle. The formula used is C = 2 * π * r
      参数:
      radius - the radius of the circle (must be positive)
      返回:
      the circumference of the circle

    • rectanglePerimeter

      public static double rectanglePerimeter(double length, double width)
      Task 2: Calculates the perimeter of a rectangle. The formula used is P = 2*length + 2*width
      参数:
      length - the length of the rectangle (must be positive)
      width - the width of the rectangle (must be positive)
      返回:
      the perimeter of the rectangle

    • trianglePerimeter

      public static double trianglePerimeter(double side1, double side2, double side3)
      Task 2: Calculates the perimeter of a triangle. The formula used is P = side1 + side2 + side3
      参数:
      side1 - the length of the first side (must be positive)
      side2 - the length of the second side (must be positive)
      side3 - the length of the third side (must be positive)
      返回:
      the perimeter of the triangle
